FIELDS.NAME: Countertop Creations LLC
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Marble Way, Suite 101, Granite City, IL 62040-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Countertop Creations LLC specializes in the professional installation of a variety of countertop and surface materials including granite, quartz, marble, and laminate. Our operations encompass residential and commercial projects, providing custom solutions that enhance both the functionality and aesthetics of spaces. Our experienced installers undergo rigorous training to ensure high-quality workmanship and compliance with all applicable building codes and safety regulations. Prior to each project, we conduct thorough risk assessments to identify potential hazards and implement safety protocols to mitigate risks. We prioritize written contracts that clearly outline the scope, payment terms, and timelines to ensure transparency with our clients. Additionally, we maintain strong relationships with reputable suppliers to guarantee the timely delivery of quality materials. Our commitment to safety and quality, combined with our attention to detail, sets us apart in the countertop installation industry.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, during a residential countertop installation, a quartz slab was accidentally chipped due to improper handling by a subcontractor. The cost of repair was $1,200.00, which has been successfully resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and onsite watchperson services during installation to ensure material safety and prevent theft.
